newsitem.title: UK: Shield drops on report of share placing.
newsitem.headline: Shield drops on report of share placing.

text.p: Shares in Shield Diagnostics Plc fell sharply in early trade on Friday after a press report that the company was considering a placing of new shares to fund an acquisition, dealers said.
The Daily Telegraph said there was market speculation that the company was considering a placing of 500,000 shares, propelling the stock down 37-1/2p at 557-1/2 by 0744 GMT.
"It is a bit of an overreaction," said one market maker, "but it is a very volatile stock."
Shield shares have rocketed since the start of February when they were trading at around 170p, propelled by hopes for its coronary thrombosis detection product.

Last month the company said it had moved closed to marketing the product after studies showed that patients with coronary heart disease had 30 percent higher levels of the clotting agent AFT that its test detects.
Shield believes its test will prove more accurate than the 500 million pounds worth of cholesterol tests taken each year.
